initial.proof: The two-endpoint compactified translation gives a jointly continuous automorphism group with unitary cocycle V(x)^*V(x+t). Its forward-generator algebra is invariant, unital and separable by rational times. The B-bimodule projection Δ∘ev0 gives conditional expectation and exactly the semigroup J+exp(-t)K. Evaluation at 0 produces off-diagonal matrix units via r=1/2, so the left GNS representation has kernel ev0 and image M2 acting on two columns. Concavity of g on positive reals, monotonicity and the endpoint cases give positivity of a_s. Its evaluation after theta_s is positive d_s times Q_s, with d_s=(1-r²)(sqrt(1+r²)-r)/2. The general finite-image proposition is valid by finite-dimensional derivative and bimodule compression of its Leibniz rule.

math: A separable forward-generated subalgebra of the compactified continuous cocycle is an injective, unital, point-norm continuous conditional-expectation dilation of a two-state relaxation. The full GNS left representation is evaluation at zero, acting on the two columns of M2, with image M2. A positive witness a_s in the evaluation kernel leaves it at every positive time. For r=exp(-s), its evolved evaluation equals ((1-r²)(sqrt(1+r²)-r)/2) times a nonzero rank-one projection. The finite-image generator proposition follows by differentiating the finite-dimensional induced endomorphisms and compressing their derivation through the bimodule expectation.
